outcome: length of the first stage of labor
cohort: 101 women with a diagnosis of fetal life-limiting condition between 2010 and 2018 in a single academic center, matched to 404 controls (women who had normal fetal anatomic survey)
finding: Women diagnosed with fetal life-limiting conditions who continued the pregnancy did not have a higher rate of adverse maternal outcomes, except for a longer first stage of labor.
mod_finding: Women with ongoing pregnancies with fetal life-limiting conditions had longer first stage of labor compared to controls.
